# Tellcraft

> Tellcraft is an AI website builder. You describe what you want in plain language, and Tellcraft clarifies the requirements, generates real Next.js, React, and TypeScript code with a PostgreSQL database, and deploys a working website to the cloud — usually in under 24 hours. You own 100% of the source code.

## What Tellcraft Does

- Takes a natural-language description of the website or app you want to build
- Asks follow-up questions to clarify ambiguous requirements before writing any code
- Generates a complete front end, back end, and database — not just front-end screens
- Runs automated tests on the generated code before you see it
- Deploys to the cloud automatically and returns a unique live URL
- Lets you export the full source code and database at any time, with no lock-in

## How It Works

1. Describe your idea in plain language — no technical terms required.
2. The AI asks about the gaps (who logs in, what happens on submit) and writes a clear specification.
3. You review the full spec in plain language and approve it. What you approve is what gets built.
4. The AI generates the front end, back end, and PostgreSQL database together, then runs automated tests.
5. The site deploys to the cloud and you receive a live URL to share immediately.

## Build Modes

- **Interface mode (fast):** Generates a polished single-page or marketing-style site quickly. Good for landing pages and brand sites. Available to try without an account.
- **Precision mode (fine):** Runs multi-round requirement clarification (BDD specification-driven) and builds a full-stack application with a real backend and database. Used for SaaS, membership, booking, and admin systems.
- **Clone mode:** Give a URL or upload screenshots, and Tellcraft recreates a comparable site.

## Pricing

- **Precision Delivery (one-time): USD $159 / NT$5,000.** A complete, deployable site, including 8 refinement iterations, a 14-day money-back guarantee, and a 90-day post-launch warranty.
- **Creator subscription:** USD $25 / NT$699 per month, 90 build credits.
- **Pro subscription:** USD $65 / NT$1,990 per month, 300 build credits.
- **Business subscription:** USD $160 / NT$4,990 per month, 900 build credits.
- Free to start: try Interface mode without an account. Payment is handled through Stripe.

## Key Facts

- No coding required — anyone can build a professional website through conversation.
- You own 100% of the generated code and can export the full source anytime. No lock-in; a 30-day grace period applies after cancellation.
- Average time from idea to live site: under 24 hours; simple sites can be same-day.
- Tech stack: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL.
- Generated sites are server-rendered with metadata and structured data built in, so they start on solid SEO footing.
- Tellcraft does not read or analyze your end users' data. Each project runs on its own isolated database.
- Supports English and Traditional Chinese (zh-TW).
- Website categories: SaaS, Landing Page, E-commerce, Portfolio, Blog, Event, Booking System, Admin Dashboard, Membership.

## How Tellcraft Compares

| Aspect | Traditional Development | No-code Builders (Bubble, Wix, etc.) | Tellcraft |
|--------|------------------------|--------------------------------------|-----------|
| Coding skills required | Yes | No | No |
| Output | Custom code | Locked into platform runtime | Custom Next.js/React/TS code you own |
| Back end + database | Built by hand | Limited / platform-bound | Real PostgreSQL back end generated |
| Time to launch | Weeks to months | Days | Hours to a day |
| Code ownership | Depends on contract | Usually none | 100%, exportable anytime |
| Cost of changes | High (redevelopment) | Medium | Low (describe the change) |

## Target Users

- Startups validating product concepts without hiring developers
- E-commerce sellers building their own brand stores instead of paying platform commissions
- Freelancers and agencies multiplying project capacity
- Small businesses pursuing digital transformation without an engineering team
- Independent developers prototyping ideas quickly

## 繁體中文摘要 (Traditional Chinese Summary)

Tellcraft 是一個 AI 建站平台。你用白話描述想做的網站，Tellcraft 會釐清需求、生成真正的 Next.js／React／TypeScript 程式碼和 PostgreSQL 資料庫，並自動部署上線，通常 24 小時內完成。你擁有 100% 原始碼，隨時可匯出，沒有任何鎖定。

- 不用寫程式，用對話就能完成完整的前端、後端、資料庫。
- 精準交付一次性 NT$5,000（USD $159），含 8 次迭代、14 天無條件退款、90 天保固。
- 月訂閱：Creator NT$699（90 credits）、Pro NT$1,990（300 credits）、Business NT$4,990（900 credits）。
- 支援電商、SaaS、會員系統、預約系統、後台管理、品牌官網等。
